Verification

How the chip is checked

Every behaviour is defined by an executable reference model (model/isa.ml) written for clarity and with no dependency on the hardware, so the two cannot share a bug. Everything else is checked against it, against independent protocol devices, or against a separately written specification.

Planted RTL bugs, all caught by random testing, the directed suite and the proof
